ui.rules.tab.0.text.1: Commander, you have an army of 40 units. Your main objective is to destroy the enemy Energy Core or leave him without any possible movements.
ui.rules.tab.0.text.2:
Important to know:

1. The game is turn-based. You can only perform one action per turn, attack or move.

2. The identities of your pieces will be unknown to the enemy, just as you will not know theirs. Their identities will be revealed once they enter in combat.
ui.rules.tab.0.text.4: The pieces of your side that are known to the enemy will be marked by an orange square.
ui.rules.tab.1.text.1: At the start, you must place your pieces on the designated tiles. Once your placement is confirmed, the enemy will do the same, and the game will begin.
ui.rules.tab.2.text.1: As a general rule, pieces move one square orthogonally (up, down, left, right). There is no diagonal movement.
ui.rules.tab.2.text.2: Your recognition unit (The [color=orange]Scout[/color]) can move any distance in a straight line, but if it advances more than one square, your opponent might be able to deduce what type of piece it is.
ui.rules.tab.2.text.3:
Restrictions:

1. You cannot jump over pieces (your own or your opponent's).

2. A piece cannot move back and force between more of 3 turns, at the next turn, the pice can't go back until another turn has passed.
ui.rules.tab.3.text.1:
A combat begins when a piece moves to a tile occupied by the rival. Both identities are revealed. A combat is decided in the following way:

1. The Higher Rank piece defeats the Lower Rank piece.
2. If the ranks are equal, ends in a draw and both pieces are destroyed.
3. In case of a special interaction, the other conditions will be ignored.

The winner keeps the tile. If the attacker wins, they advance, and if the defender wins, they stay in their place.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.1.text.2:
The  vital  heart  of  each  faction.  It  is  immobile  and  defenseless.

[color=crimson]Its  destruction  results  in  an  immediate  power  collapse  and  total  defeat[/color].

Protect  it  at  all  costs.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.2.text.2:
An  agile  drone  designed  for  a  single  purpose:  high-level  infiltration.

While  it  is  the  weakest  unit  in  a  fair  fight,  it  [color=crimson]can  instantly  destroy  the  enemy  [color=orange]War Machine[/color]  if  it  strikes  first[/color].

Make it count.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.3.text.2:
Agile  reconnaissance  drones.

They  [color=crimson]can  move  any  number  of  tiles  in  a  straight  line[/color]  horizontal  or  vertical.

However, [color=crimson]moving them more than one tile at a time will spoil their identity[/color].

Use them strategically
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.4.text.2:
Specialized  units  equipped  with  high-tech  camouflage.

They  are  the  only  pieces  [color=crimson]capable  of  safely  dismantling  automated  [color=orange]Turrets[/color][/color],  though  they  are  weak  in  standard  combat.

It  wouldn't  be  a  good  idea  to  put  them  in  an  unknown  combat.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.5.text.2:
Standard  human  reinforcements  used  to  hold  the  frontline.

No  special  properties,  just  the  weakest  normal  unit.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.6.text.2:
Fast  and  efficient  soldiers  enhanced  with  light  cybernetic  implants.

No  special  properties.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.7.text.2:
High  mobility  mechanical  quadrupeds  designed  for  rapid  interception.

No  special  properties.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.8.text.2:
Mechanized  assault  units  optimized  for  combat  and  possessing  a  structural  resistance  superior  to  any  human.

No  special  properties.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.9.text.2:
Heavy-duty  robots  built  to  endure  and  dominate  in  direct  engagement.

No  special  properties.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.10.text.2:
A  high-ranking  cyborg  guard  with  nearly  non-existent  organic  parts.

No  special  properties.
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.11.text.2:
Massive  mecha  piloted  by  the  faction's  supreme  AI.

The  most  powerful  unit  on  the  battlefield,  [color=crimson]vulnerable  only  to  the  [color=orange]Phantom's[/color]  malware  attack[/color].
ui.rules.tab.4.piece.12.text.2:
Static  defensive  systems.

They  automatically  [color=crimson]destroy  any  unit  that  attacks  them[/color]  regardless  of  rank,  except  for  [color=orange]Saboteurs[/color]  who  can  bypass  and  disable  them.
